240-3899-5470-6968.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat from step 2.

2511-4153--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2511-4153--5--195.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Resourceful Defense trigger.
Resolve Resourceful Defense's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1.
Repeat.

3967-7084-7889.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2073-5686-7876-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Consulate Dreadnought from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Consulate Dreadnought enters, Kolodin triggers, causing Consulate Dreadnought to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Consulate Dreadnought.
When Consulate Dreadnought dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

779-4970-5751-7692.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding Dakmor Salvage.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1018-2104-5144.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Skullwinder and exiling Ephemerate.
When Skullwinder enters, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Skullwinder.
When Skullwinder enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

206-339-677-6797.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Brigid, Clachan's Heart // Brigid, Doun's Mind

1909-4486-7203.description:
Activate Brigid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Brigid
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, giving creatures you control all creature types and base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Repeat.
1909-4486-7203.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Mirror Entity to make your creatures infinitely large until end of turn.

2464-3713-4311-5078.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2464-3713-4311-5078.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

6517-6797-7084.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Dragonback Assault triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

851-1648-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
851-1648-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Nissa of Shadowed Boughs
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

893-1477-4853.description:
Activate Myr Turbine by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing the Myr.
When the Myr dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Myr Turbine.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

934-1486-1753-7014.description:
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the North Pole Patrol ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, untapping North Pole Patrol.
Repeat
934-1486-1753-7014.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5007-5256-6972.description:
If Morselhoarder has any -1/-1 counters on it, activate it by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat step 1 as necessary until Morselhoarder has no -1/-1 counters on it.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Morselhoarder.
When Morselhoarder dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

4050-4484-5075-6896.easyPrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
4050-4484-5075-6896.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} due to Green Goblin.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ebondeath, adding {B}.
When Ebondeath dies, Ogre Slumlord triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2034-6872--5.easyPrerequisites: One of the persist creatures does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2034-6872--5.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a persist creature that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Long Feng trigger.
Resolve the Long Feng trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other persist creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2084-4089.notablePrerequisites: Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore is a copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm.
2084-4089.description: Activate Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore by paying {1}{U}, shuffling Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

277-880-2692.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
277-880-2692.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Felidar Retreat and Tiller Engine trigger.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping the land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

864-2281-2438-4191.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Eternal Witness.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness dies, Saffi triggers, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Saffi by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Repeat.

696-2645-3094-4091.notablePrerequisites:
Black Market has at least seven charge counters on it.
Aphetto Alchemist does not have summoning sickness.
696-2645-3094-4091.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Black Market's second ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Black Market's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Black Market's trigger, adding at least seven {B}.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, untapping Lithoform Engine.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Aphetto Alchemist.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

927-4781.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Jon Irenicus triggers, causing an opponent who controls no Islands to gain control of Dandân.
Dandân triggers, causing the opponent to sacrifice it.
However, Dandân cannot be sacrificed due to its ability granted by Jon Irenicus.
Dandân triggers again, creating a mandatory infinite loop that causes the game to end in a draw.

1017-4052-4186.notablePrerequisites:
"Squirrel" chosen with Kindred Discovery.
Wizard Class is level three.
You have a way to draw a card.
1017-4052-4186.description:
Draw a card.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
The Squirrel enters the battlefield, triggering Kindred Discovery, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1987-2510-3941-4125.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.
1987-2510-3941-4125.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Coveted Jewel and Shipwreck Dowser, blinking them.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Coveted Jewel enters the battlefield, draw three cards.
Repeat.

2281-4681-5256.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Karmic Guide
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Karmic Guide
When Karmic Guide dies, Saffi triggers, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

2441-5003-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Rasputin Dreamweaver.
Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Rasputin Dreamweaver from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve Altar of Dementia's ability, milling target player a number of cards equal to Rasputin Dreamweaver's power.
Activate Rasputin Dreamweaver's first activated ability seven times, adding seven {C}.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite colorless mana, you may repeat this loop with any other creatures you control, effectively blinking them through sacrifice and reanimation.
